integrity: The theorem is proved combinatorially; reproducible finite enumeration is supporting evidence, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Binary VT checksum codes only, exactly two deletions; maximized over syndrome classes; no per-class sharpness or improved decoding algorithm claimed. Unindexed equivalent earlier results cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp worst-case two-deletion list size for binary Varshamov–Tenengolts codes
